questions.question: What did Asaph confess he had nearly done?
options: His heart had grown bitterly cold, for he forgot all the kindness that the LORD had so often shown him
His feet had almost stumbled, for he envied the arrogant when he saw the prosperity of the wicked
His hands had grown weak and weary, for the long labor of the righteous seemed to him entirely in vain
His eyes had grown faint and dim, for he could no longer see the straight path that God had set before him
questions.answer: His feet had almost stumbled, for he envied the arrogant when he saw the prosperity of the wicked

questions.question: Where did Asaph finally understand the end of the wicked?
options: When he went into the sanctuary of God
When he cried out to God in the night
When he heard the words of the prophet
When he remembered the deeds of old
questions.answer: When he went into the sanctuary of God

questions.question: Asaph concludes that it is good to be near God, his refuge.
Whom have I in heaven but you? And there is nothing on earth that I desire besides _____.
God is the strength of my heart and my _____ forever.
